name: 三界神话完整版
group_note: 三界神话「泉州师院」 (San Jie Shen Hua, "quanzhou shiyuan" edition), fourth of the 5-lib sjsh family cluster. Same lineage as sjsh/sjshv150/sjshv2578bb but this snapshot's master.lpc/securityd.lpc/logind.lpc are NOT byte-identical to the earlier three -- master.lpc has no CHANNEL_D call in log_error()/standard_trace() at all (§7.60 does not apply here), securityd.lpc's valid_read() never overwrites the driver's user arg (§7.59 does not apply), and there is no sited.lpc (no loopback gate to work around). WASM pass fixed: (1) the familiar convertd.lpc byte-level corruption (45 lines, same 'stray non-UTF8 bytes before a closing quote, last byte 0x5C escapes the quote' pattern as sjsh/sjshv150, same 0xce/0xb2/0xee/0x96/0xa3 illegal-character signature at line 258) -- fixed with the standard byte-level Python script. (2) §8.1-class check_legal_name() in adm/daemons/logind.lpc: the i%2 parity gate assumed 2-byte GBK characters and a byte-count length bound (2-12); under this driver's UTF8-codepoint string indexing this misjudges odd-character-count Chinese names -- rewrote to check every character via is_chinese(name[i..i]) with no parity gate, and corrected the length bound to character count (1-6, matching the user-facing '一到六个中文字' message). adm/simul_efun/chinese.lpc's is_chinese() was already a correct codepoint-range check (0x4e00-0x9fff) -- no fix needed there. No emoted.lpc/message.lpc/channeld.lpc bugs found in this snapshot (checked directly, none present/needed). Admin seeded: fluffos (admin) in adm/etc/wizlist (this lib's wiz_levels tops out at (admin), same tier ceiling as sjsh). Registration flow verified end-to-end in one continuous WASM client session: GB/BIG5 encoding select -> not-a-student gate -> 'new' keyword -> English id -> Chinese name -> admin password + confirm -> regular password (must differ from admin password) + confirm -> email (requires xxx@xxx.xxx format) -> homepage/ICQ (optional, blank ok) -> gender -> gift-declined -> character stat allocation screen, zero unexpected errors throughout. Admin permission directly confirmed via the post-login banner text '您的系统权限目前是：(admin)'. LPC formatter run across all 11658 .lpc files (11364 written, 83 errors on messy legacy code, 211 unchanged); reverted 2 files (panshi_dan.lpc, npc/mm.lpc) with confirmed pre-existing-corruption re-spacing -- both source files were missing string quotes entirely even before formatting (author-side corruption predating this pass, not something the formatter introduced), matching the documented 'pre-existing unbalanced quotes' blind spot; the formatter's re-spacing on top of already-quote-less content was reverted rather than hand-repaired. No :: parent-call split hits. Diff-reviewed the only case-heavy formatted file (d/calvin/esman.lpc) -- clean, no swallowed statements after any case label. Diff-reviewed all 4 map.lpc files present via whitespace-normalized line-set comparison against pre-format blobs -- all differences are brace-placement style only (K&R merge), zero content changes. Post-formatter re-verified with the same full registration flow -- clean, admin permission still (admin).
